facts.business: The Baroda Rayon Corporation Limited is engaged in real estate development, recognizing revenue from real estate projects at a point in time upon satisfying performance obligations.
key_risks: Revenue recognition for real estate projects involves significant judgement in identifying performance obligations and determining transfer of control
Pending litigations and wage settlements with material amounts and significant management judgement in estimating liabilities
Inventory valuation of ongoing and completed real estate projects involves estimates based on prevailing market conditions, current prices and expected dates
